newsitem.title: USA: General American to buy back 600,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: General American to buy back 600,000 shares.

text.p: General American Investors Inc said Wednesday its board had authorized the repurchase of up to 600,000 shares.
The repurchases will be made when the shares are trading at a discount of at least 10 percent from the underlying net asset value, it said.

General American, a closed-end fund, said the repurchase continues a program begun in March 1995. So far, it has bought back about 4.375 million shares for over $93 million at an average discount of 15.8 percent, it said.
So far this year it has bought back 985,000 shares for more than $21.8 million at an average discount of 15.7 per cent, it said.
